text:
StarvedSteve would like to welcome you to this clipboard bell thingy. This will have notifications for additions, updates and fixes, as well as report possible broken scripts when the devs update DST Mobile.

Tap the bell icon again or any empty space to close the notifications!
Fixed HP Bar's (17.5.1) Remote mistakenly labeled local. Added (17.5.2)  as an alternative remote hp bar option so the HP bar only works for mobs with 1400 MAX HP and above! Less clutter amirite?

Updated (7) Move Items (One tap to move items) Buttons are now hidden when there's no relevant storage for them, now auto activates when there is. The text is replaced with icons. MW Watch seemed to be missing from the clips but it is added now. Teehee
Fixed (10) Season and moon cycle info's  same function name with Move Items.

Added (20) minimap, go to https://jarlini69420-bit.github.io/Read-only-Public-Clipboard-/dst-button-placer  first, upload an uncropped screenshot then paste (20.1) in the Paste any script  box then tap find coordinates. The button that is generated is the center of the minimap. Copy the updated script then run it in your console. Repeat until you like where it sits!
Removed Networking Messages for Auto-run and Farm tiller.
Added MISC Prevent other characters from picking up Winona's Winbot
Added Testserver Free crafting and Godmode
Updated minimap (20.2) to prevent possible movement or pinch zoom issues. Changed (20.4) to an optional toggle to hide and show the minimap! Tap the brain icon to hide/show

Added (21) Auto-hitches/unhitches beefalo at grooming stations and alerts you with a bell if you mount without one. Dismount beefalo near a grooming station, to mount, just tap on the hitched beefalo! Character will walk to the beefalo, unhitch, feed then mount in one go! DEPENDENCY: AUTORUN (12)
Fixed a crash caused by a tap handler on beefalo surviving character swaps
